dashboard.title: LakeTS Ingest Monitoring
dashboard.description: Real-time ingest rate and partition growth monitoring

panels.title: Ingest Rate (rows/sec) - Last Hour
panels.description: Estimated ingest rate based on partition row counts

targets.rawSql: SELECT lakets.time_bucket('5 minutes'::interval, time) as time, count(*) / 300.0 as rows_per_sec FROM $hypertable WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT chunk_name, row_count FROM lakets.show_chunks('$hypertable') WHERE row_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY range_start DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT chunk_name, range_start, range_end, status, created_at FROM lakets.show_chunks('$hypertable') ORDER BY range_start DESC LIMIT 20

list.name: hypertable
list.label: Hypertable
list.query: SELECT table_name FROM lakets._hypertable_registry ORDER BY table_name
